overview: Based on the published agenda, the Utility Committee of the Village of Kronenwetter was scheduled to meet to address the 2027 budget, a second draft of the 2027-2036 Capital Improvements Program, and discussion of a septic tank ordinance. The meeting was also set to receive reports from the Director of Public Works and Utilities and the Finance/Treasurer.

agenda.item: Approval of Minutes - June 2, 2026 Utility Committee Meeting Minutes
Director of Public Works and Utilities Report

discussions.body: The committee was scheduled to review and consider approval of the June 2, 2026 Utility Committee meeting minutes.
The committee was set to discuss the septic tank ordinance as old business, with possible action to be taken on this matter.
The committee was scheduled to discuss the 2027 budget as new business, with possible action anticipated on this item.
The committee was expected to consider the second draft of the Capital Improvements Program budget covering the period 2027-2036, with possible action to be taken.

publicComment: Public comment was scheduled to be received for up to 15 minutes total, with a three-minute time limit per person, subject to extension at the Chief Presiding Officer's discretion.
actionItems: Scheduled to vote on approval of June 2, 2026 meeting minutes
